description: Invented vectors for the Claude Code adapter, revision 5 (docs/desk-native-participant-contract.md section 21). Page-level cases (no seed): availability with the off-Mac Claude pin and the host-not-approved reason, a Claude start, replies the page codec must refuse, prepared runs that carry context, and the stdin layout with the first-trial bound. Then the fake-CLI host cases (adapter PR 3e) in section 19's seeded form, under the off-Mac pin with one earlier turn as context, each stating the stdin a start it launches hands the CLI. No real model names, accounts or text.
